title: Faces in the ceiling?
content: Anyone else look up at the ceiling and see living faces staring down, Mount Rushmore style? I've been holding on to this one for awhile now but during a lucid moment in mall world I looked up at the ceiling and saw moving faces looking down in a grand lobby area. Best example I can think of other than Mount Rushmore is the sun baby face from Teletubbies looking down but it was multiple adult human faces.
